decisions.reason: The conferencing service remains a low-cost option with unresolved demand, so it is kept open while uncertainty persists.
Its validated adoption for data centre connectivity and strong growth in that segment make it a valuable option to retain.
The portal is a low-cost digital extension that supports voice services, so it remains open at little cost.
Direct voice connection is a declining legacy service with no new evidence of value, so the option should be abandoned to reallocate resources.
